segments.name: Toast, Inc.
segments.description: Provides restaurants and food and beverage retailers a cloud-based platform of software, payments, hardware and financial technology solutions.
segments.evidence: We have one reportable segment, Toast, Inc., consisting of a comprehensive platform of software-as-a-service, or SaaS, products, financial technology solutions, including integrated payment processing, restaurant-grade hardware, and a broad ecosystem of third-party partners.

revenueModel.text: Restaurants and food and beverage retailers pay subscription fees for software access, transaction fees for payment processing, and fees for hardware and professional services.
revenueModel.evidence: Subscription services revenue is generated from fees charged to customers for access to our software applications.
